name: HELCOM EG Phyto biovolume file (PEG_BVOL)
reported_coverage: republished annually as a new version
relevant_variables: taxon geometric shapes and size classes and biovolume and carbon coefficients
proposed_role: conversion authority for Tier C carbon estimates
notes: Not an observation dataset. Must be version-frozen and checksummed before any Tier C conversion. North Sea taxon coverage requires audit given Baltic-centred origin.

name: Nordic Microalgae NOMP biovolume list
reported_coverage: mirror and extension of the HELCOM list
relevant_variables: geometric shapes and biovolume references
notes: Treated as a mirror of DS22 rather than an independent authority.

name: NIOZ Wadden Sea phytoplankton
reported_coverage: NIOZ-Texel jetty at Marsdiep tidal inlet since 1974 at roughly 40 samples per year
relevant_variables: phytoplankton species densities and Secchi and SPM and nutrients and chlorophyll and primary production
notes: Absent from the original register. Tidal-inlet jetty station with strongly local hydrography. Duplicate check required against DS02 and DS03.

name: OSPAR COMP4 COMPEAT input data files
reported_coverage: Greater North Sea and Celtic Seas and Bay of Biscay for assessment period 2015-2020
relevant_variables: harmonized in-situ chlorophyll and nutrients aggregated to COMP4 assessment areas
proposed_role: comparator and non-PhyC baseline and Stage 1 known-item recall benchmark
notes: Open R implementation at https://github.com/ices-tools-prod/COMPEAT. COMP4 also ingests remote sensing so independence must be checked per input stream.

name: EMODnet Chemistry aggregated eutrophication product
reported_coverage: Greater North Sea
relevant_variables: in-situ chlorophyll-a and nutrients as validated and harmonized aggregates
notes: SeaDataNet ODV and NetCDF plus OGC WMS and WFS and CSW. Feeds Copernicus so independence from the assimilation chain must be established per source.

name: SMHI IFCB imaging and annotated reference library
reported_coverage: Skagerrak and Kattegat and Baltic Proper
relevant_variables: imaged plankton with manual classifications supporting biovolume
notes: Data flow into SHARK. R client iRfcb available. Imaged size range and classifier performance require audit.

name: COSYNA Hereon FerryBox ships of opportunity
reported_coverage: routes Cuxhaven-Immingham and Buesum-Helgoland and Halden-Zeebrugge-Immingham-Moss; 2002-2005 release published
relevant_variables: chlorophyll-a fluorescence and phytoplankton group fluorescence and turbidity and oxygen and salinity and temperature
notes: Fluorescence is not carbon and is subject to photoacclimation and non-photochemical quenching. Surface-only and route-constrained. Related pCO2 series doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.930383.

name: LifeWatch Belgium HPLC pigment series
reported_coverage: Belgian Part of the North Sea reported as monthly since 2002
relevant_variables: HPLC pigments supporting CHEMTAX group decomposition
proposed_role: lifeform comparator and triangulation for DS10
notes: CHEMTAX ratios are regionally tuned and non-unique. No direct total-biomass conversion. Coverage statement requires verification against the provider record.

name: Inner Oslofjord phytoplankton 1896-2020
reported_coverage: inner Oslofjord principally station Dk1/S1 in Vestfjorden; approximately monthly 2006-2020; 605 sampling events and 22636 records reported
relevant_variables: cell abundance and biomass in ug C/L for 1994-2020 with gaps and 412 accepted taxa
notes: Inner fjord and therefore outside both the frozen domain and the Skagerrak/Kattegat external-transfer definition. Published title refers to eastern Norway which overstates the spatial scope. Pre-1920 records not comparable.

name: GBIF as an aggregator family
reported_coverage: global
relevant_variables: occurrence and sampling-event records
notes: DS23 and Norwegian holdings publish to GBIF and not to EurOBIS. Section 7 deduplication rule must add GBIF.

name: Copernicus Marine In Situ TAC North-West Shelf product
reported_coverage: North-West Shelf
relevant_variables: in-situ chlorophyll and oxygen and nutrients
notes: Superficially ideal and North-West Shelf scoped. Draws on the same chlorophyll streams that inform the ocean-colour chain so it breaches the assimilation boundary in docs/CONTEXT.md. Recorded explicitly as considered and rejected.

name: Harmful Algal Event Database
reported_coverage: ICES area since 1985
relevant_variables: harmful algal event records
notes: Phaeocystis is systematically under-reported because events rarely carry demonstrable economic impact. Published northern-Europe review identifies only two North Sea Phaeocystis entries. Absence of an entry is not evidence of absence of a bloom so negative windows cannot be defined.

name: PhytoBase and MAREDAT global syntheses
reported_coverage: global open ocean
relevant_variables: occurrence records and gridded functional-type carbon
proposed_role: taxonomy crosswalk and recall aid only
notes: Assembled from OBIS and GBIF and CPR and monitoring programmes already in the register. Inclusion would inflate the dataset count with duplicates.

name: BODC NERC Shelf Sea Biogeochemistry cruise and glider holdings
reported_coverage: campaign-based
relevant_variables: chlorophyll and nutrients and phytoplankton and primary production
notes: Campaign-based rather than recurrent and therefore fails the three-year repeated-observation criterion in section 4.1.

name: SMHI Kattegat and Skagerrak phytoplankton
reported_coverage: unchanged from section 6
relevant_variables: carbon in ug C/L derived from biovolume via HELCOM PEG and NOMP lists in addition to biovolume and abundance and chlorophyll
proposed_role: external-transfer primary reference and Stage 1 reference implementation
notes: Tier raised from B. Programmatic access supported by SHARK4R and iRfcb R clients. Remains an external-transfer region under the frozen Stage 0 assignment.

name: Helgoland Roads PANGAEA publication series
reported_coverage: 145 child datasets covering 1962-2023 sampled every weekday
reported_access: login required and CC-BY-4.0 stated to take effect after moratorium ends
relevant_variables: total abundance and total biovolume and biomass as carbon resolved by group including diatoms split into centrales and pennales and dinoflagellates and silicoflagellates and coccolithophorids and flagellates and green algae and ciliates
proposed_role: lifeform dominance by carbon share and temporal-resolution sentinel
notes: Only source identified in either run able to express lifeform dominance as a carbon share. Inspected annual carbon dataset doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.862910 renders as licensing unknown with contact-the-PI terms. Reclassified from public acquisition to request-and-verify. Licence enquiry must be logged through the manual and contact channel.

name: Sylt Roads
reported_coverage: quantitative microplankton reported for 1992-2013; semi-quantitative net microplankton continues to the present
relevant_variables: microplankton counts
proposed_role: external coastal sentinel with reduced weight
notes: Two distinct series. Net selectivity plus semi-quantitative enumeration places modern years at Tier D or E. Quantitative window may end before much of the reanalysis period. Annual semi-quantitative datasets include doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.937744 and doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.937747.

name: VLIZ LifeWatch phytoplankton FlowCam
reported_coverage: May 2017 to August 2024 with 9 nearshore stations monthly and 8 offshore stations seasonally
relevant_variables: cell density and taxon counts across 138 biological groups including 76 diatom and 17 dinoflagellate groups over 55-300 um ESD
proposed_role: large-cell lifeform validation and method sensitivity
notes: Coverage extended to 2024. The 55 um lower bound is confirmed and remains the binding constraint on total-biomass interpretation. Related identifiers doi:10.14284/710 and doi:10.14284/680.

name: Scottish Coastal Observatory Stonehaven
reported_coverage: 1997-2017 weekly
relevant_variables: phytoplankton counts as first 400 cells and fields of view and presence/absence and target species and flow cytometry plus environmental and Secchi and temperature and zooplankton
proposed_role: external-transfer validation and pico/nano gap filler
notes: Flow-cytometry resource addresses the pico and nano gap that section 8 makes conditional on the unreleased DS21. First-400-cells protocol yields relative composition rather than absolute density so the fields-of-view resource is required for abundance.

name: Cefas SmartBuoy phytoplankton
reported_coverage: unchanged from section 6
relevant_variables: full-community Utermoehl counts in cells per litre
proposed_role: core for eligible North Sea stations
notes: Approximately weekly automated 150 mL samples preserved in acidified Lugol iodine. Also published through DASSH which must be linked as an aggregator copy under section 7 rather than counted separately.

name: SMHI SHARK API documentation endpoint
reported_coverage: not established
relevant_variables: unknown
notes: Retrieval returned only a Swagger UI page shell with no endpoint or licence content. The API surface remains unverified and must be established during Stage 1.
